result.summary: The food delivery app page appears well-structured and visually consistent. No significant broken elements were detected beyond acceptable design patterns like scrollable carousels and content extending past the viewport.

issues.description: The two favorite (heart) icons use inconsistent styling. The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has a white heart on a light circular background, while the pizza card below has a white heart on a dark circular background, creating visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart/favorite icon background treatment across all restaurant cards for a consistent look.
